description.zh: 坐席账号名称，实例内唯一（登录名）
description.en: The name of the agent account. The name must be unique within the instance. It is used as the logon name.

description.zh: 客户请求唯一id，用于幂等校验，可以用uuid生成
description.en: The unique client request ID used for idempotency verification. You can use UUID to generate the ID.

description.zh: AICCS实例ID，在智能联络中心控制台上可以看到
description.en: The ID of the AICCS instance. You can view the instance ID in the Intelligent Contact Center console.
